body:
## Goal
Build a fast, privacy-first, 100% client-side Next.js web application that parses Stockbit dividend calendar CSV exports, identifies historical dividend cycles for IDX tickers, and flags stocks entering optimal **"Buy Windows" (60–90 days / 2–3 months before estimated Cum Date)**.

## Dependency Graph
```mermaid
graph TD
    T1[#1: Setup Test Harness & Shared Types] --> T2[#2: Stockbit CSV Parser & Normalizer]
    T2 --> T3[#3: Built-in IDX Sample Dataset & Loader]
    T3 --> CP1{#4: Checkpoint 1 - Parser Suite}

    CP1 --> T4[#5: Historical Cycle & Next Cum Estimator]
    T4 --> T5[#6: Buy Window Classifier & Radar Screener]
    T5 --> T6[#7: Date, Format, and Export Utilities]
    T6 --> CP2{#8: Checkpoint 2 - Engine Suite}

    CP2 --> T7[#9: UI Primitive Base & Layout Theme]
    T7 --> T8[#10: CSV Dropzone & Demo Data Trigger]
    T8 --> T9[#11: Filter Bar & Summary Stats]
    T9 --> T10[#12: Sortable Radar Table & History View]
    T10 --> T11[#13: Seasonality Timeline & Watchlist Exporter]
    T11 --> T12[#14: Page Dashboard Integration & Verification]
    T12 --> CP3{#15: Checkpoint 3 - Production Verification}
```

---

## Phase 1: Foundation & CSV Parser
- [x] #1 Task 1: Setup Test Harness & Shared Types
- [x] #2 Task 2: Stockbit CSV Parser & Normalizer
- [ ] #3 Task 3: Built-in IDX Sample Dataset & Loader
- [ ] #4 Checkpoint 1: Parser Suite Verification

## Phase 2: Dividend Cycle Engine & Screener Logic
- [ ] #5 Task 4: Historical Cycle Detection & Next Cum Date Estimator
- [ ] #6 Task 5: Buy Window Classifier & Radar Screener Pipeline
- [ ] #7 Task 6: Date, Format, and Export Utilities
- [ ] #8 Checkpoint 2: Engine Suite Verification

## Phase 3: Screener UI & User Experience
- [ ] #9 Task 7: UI Primitive Base & Layout Theme
- [ ] #10 Task 8: CSV Dropzone & Demo Data Trigger
- [ ] #11 Task 9: Multi-Parameter Filter Bar & Summary Stats
- [ ] #12 Task 10: Sortable Radar Table & History View
- [ ] #13 Task 11: Seasonality Timeline & Watchlist Exporter
- [ ] #14 Task 12: Page Dashboard Integration & Verification
- [ ] #15 Checkpoint 3: Final Production Verification

### Context
Build a 12-month seasonality visualization displaying dividend events and buy window distribution across the year, alongside a watchlist export component (CSV download and 1-click clipboard copy).

### Phase
Phase 3: Screener UI & User Experience

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `components/SeasonalityChart.tsx` renders 12-month timeline / heatmap of upcoming dividend accumulation windows.
- [ ] `components/WatchlistExport.tsx` provides:
  - Download filtered screener results as `.csv` file.
  - 1-click "Copy Tickers to Clipboard" (e.g. `ASII,BBCA,BBRI,PTBA`) with confirmation toast.
- [ ] Export actions only include currently filtered opportunities.

### Verification
CSV download produces valid formatted file and clipboard copy yields comma-separated ticker string.

Blocked by #12

  - Search input with debounced ticker / company filtering.

  - Active Buy Windows count.
  - Approaching Windows count.
